remarks: Coming soon! This 2 bedroom, 1.25 bath home offers over 1,700 sq ft and a pool on a quiet, tree-lined street. A huge family room addition with French doors opens to the backyard. It was first built as a primary bedroom and could easily become one again by adding closets back. The garage has its own electrical panel and an exit door, giving it possible ADU potential. The kitchen and bath are ready for your personal touch, and the home is priced to reflect the updates needed. Just 2 minutes from the 605, 10 minutes from Uptown Whittier, and close to hiking trails. Bring your vision!
